response.sql:
WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM scanconservation AS c
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
), shares AS (
  SELECT healtheval,
         record_count,
         CAST(record_count AS REAL) / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
), above_average AS (
  SELECT record_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: A missing healtheval is one status group; counts include only conservation records whose zoneref matches an existing site, and shares use the total of those matched records.
